goal: Speed up block template validation latency for miners and Stratum v2 services
Avoid polluting the main coins cache during dummy template checks
agreement: Unaddressed objection: cache check does not prevent reentrancy during prefetch (Yudis-bit)
Contested objection: prefetching can retain ~250 MiB on invalid blocks without PoW protection (l0rinc)
Agreed reentrancy fix has not yet been pushed by the author (l0rinc)
Concept approval to speed up block checks for Stratum v2 services (Sjors, optout21)

why: P3 because it optimizes block template checking rather than the core block connection or IBD path
Reduces template validation latency and avoids cache pollution for miners and Stratum v2 services
